{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows with negative customer_age (implausible)
valid_sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers using only valid age data
mean_age_converted_valid = valid_sales_df[valid_sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
mean_age_converted_valid"}
